text:
marta: Noticed invoice credits in Stripe but NetSuite shows none for window 2026-03-22 23:00-23:45. billing-report job marked success but ledger delta is wrong.
josh: Which job run? show importer logs.
marta: billing-report-2026-03-22-23-agg. NetSuite importer: "skipping event: filter mismatch (origin!=webhook)" for ~85 events.
rachel: Why filter on origin? Backfill events use origin=backfill historically. Did someone tighten the filter?
netsuite-bot: ingestion: processed=342 skipped=85 reason=origin_filter
billing-bot: stripe: credit_note.created x85 (meta: job=backfill-2026-03-22)
emily: It was a safety change to prevent CSV/manual dupes. Backfill wasn't whitelisted so importer skipped them.
josh: Immediate: pause GL posting, run importer in dry-run with a whitelist for this backfill id, and produce affected customer list.
marta: GL poster paused: kubectl scale deployment gl-poster --replicas=0 -n prod.
rachel: I'll prepare import config to accept origin in (webhook,backfill) when metadata.backfill_job matches, and tag imported_via=backfill.
emily: Also check for duplicate credit_notes in Stripe for same invoice (retries could have created multiples).
josh: I'll run duplicate query: SELECT invoice_id, count(*) FROM stripe_credit_notes WHERE metadata->>'job'='backfill-2026-03-22' GROUP BY invoice_id HAVING count(*)>1;
marta: CS already getting pings. Draft comms to say we're reconciling and not issuing refunds until confirmed.
rachel: Draft: "We're investigating unexpected credits from a billing backfill. Finance is reconciling records and will notify impacted customers within 48 hours. No refunds will be issued until reconciliation completes."
emily: Ops: make importer origin filter configurable and log sample payloads for skipped events. Ticket FIN-2026-17 opened.
josh: Actions: rachel-run controlled import & tag records (ETA 40m); emily-run duplicate detection; marta-coordinate CS comms & hold manual adjustments; josh-audit recent deploy that added strict origin check.
marta: Uploaded list: drive.redwood.com/finance/missed_backfill_credits_2026-03-22.csv
emarta: Marking P0 for finance ops. Revert strict origin filter if recent.
emely: Note (typo): ensure backfill job attaches import_hint=backfill next time so importer can route correctly.
